QuestInfo.name: Lania's Distress
QuestInfo.1: #p1032205# is remembering more and more. You're the only person she can turn to for help. Go to her home before it's too late.

0.0: Luminous, we need to talk.\r\n#L0##bAre you all right?#l\n#k
0.1: I'm fine, I just... I remembered a bit of my past. Please, come to see me.

yes.0: I'm just a little disoriented. I think our connection is getting deeper.

no.0: Sure. Fine. It's not like you almost blew me up or anything.

1.0: How come you only visit when I invite you over? Don't you miss me?\r\n#L0##b...#l\n#k
1.1: I know, I know. You're busy fighting your war with the Black Mage. I just wish you'd drop by more often...

yes.0: I've been remembering Lucia lately. We used to stroll through Harmony when you were little...
yes.1: I want to give you something. From back then. Think of me whenever you look at it, okay?
